屋子里一下子静了下来，许丽轻声说道：“有！”
“真的？他们是谁？说来听听！”许紫烟好奇地问道。
“我现在相信你是住在偏远的山村了，紫烟。你竟然对大陆上的风云人物都不知道！可想而知你呆的地方是多么的闭塞。”说到这里，感慨地看了一眼许紫烟，轻叹了一声：“如果不是你的叔叔发现了你，一个绝世人才就这么被埋没了。”
许紫烟被夸的不好意思地脸一红，有些扭捏地轻声说道：“许丽，你就别嘲笑我了，我见识少，你快说给我听听。”
许丽突然脸色一整，极其认真地对许紫烟说道：“紫烟，你将来一定不是池中之物，一定会一飞冲天，到时候不要忘了我们。”
“是啊！紫烟，你可不要忘了我们。”其他几个人此时也极其认真地看着许紫烟说道，眼中透露着期盼。
许紫烟突然被大家弄得手足无措，不过她也迅即明白这是大家想像到了自己的未来，希望自己成为强者之后，能够对他们照顾一二。因为不客气地说，眼前的这四个人，从三岁开始修炼，一直到了十五岁才勉强达到后天第五层，也确实没有了什么大的发展。就是许紫烟给他们不停地服食丹药，也不可能成为巅峰般的存在。所以他们有这个想法也是正常的事情。
想清楚了这一切的许紫烟，很快便调整好了心态，她知道此时自己如果还在谦虚，恐怕会被大家误会。于是微笑着说道：
“如果我将来真的托你们吉言一飞冲天，紫烟一定不会忘记大家今日的情意。”
“好！”众人大喜，抚掌大笑。
笑毕之后，许丽略微组织了一下语言，轻声地说道：
“这片大陆很大，咱们许家位于大陆的北方，凭着我们的地位知道的并不多。我只知道在北方有着四大家族，分别是巨阙城的韩家，沧浪城的周家，南林城的杨家和我们中都城的许家。
据说沧浪城的周家出了一个天才，叫作周浩，他是周家当代家主的公子。三岁修炼五岁突破后天第五层，七岁进入先天。如今十八岁，却已经是炼气期第五层的修为。
而南林城的杨家同样出了一个天才，叫作扬玲珑，是杨家当代家主女儿，她的进程和周浩几乎一样，如今同样是十八岁，同样是炼气期第五层的修为。
至于巨阙城的韩家倒是没有出什么天才人物，据说韩家最出色的年轻一代是一个叫作韩城的公子，今天十七岁，却只有炼气期第二层的修为。而我们许家最出色的是九伯父的儿子，叫作许天狼，据说就要突破到炼气期第三层了。”
“这么说最厉害的就是周浩和扬玲珑这两个人了？”
许紫烟轻声问道。她听了许丽的话之后，心里不禁有些失望。如今自己只有十五岁，而且只修炼的几个月的时间，就达到了炼气期第二层的境界。
她相信在自己丹药的帮助下，等到自己的制符术达到三品的时候，就可以制作符阵。到那时给自己制作一个聚灵符阵，在丹药和符阵的双重帮助下，自己的境界一定会更快，虽然自己起步晚，但是自己坚信，等到自己十八岁的时候，自己一定不会比那个扬玲珑和周浩差。而且随着时间的推移，自己一定会超越他们，甚至将他们远远地甩在后面。
“不是！”许丽摇了摇头说道：“这只是在北方，其他的地方我不知道。而且这只是俗世中的高手，至于那些宗门中的弟子，就不是我们这些人能够知道的了。不过有一点可以确定的是，那些宗门内的高手一定比俗世中的人修为高出很多。那扬玲珑和周浩如果进入宗门，不用进入什么大的宗门，就是那些小宗门，恐怕连中等都算不上。”

“真的？你怎么知道？”
“这方面许凌知道的多些，就让许凌说吧。”许丽将目光望向了许凌。
许凌也不推辞，接着许丽的话头说道：“我的远房表哥在五年前被一个叫作赤阳宗的小宗门选去了。他进入赤阳宗的时候是炼气期第一层的修为，去年他回来探亲是说，炼气期第一层的修为在赤阳宗是最低的修为，像玉玲珑和周强那种修为的人在赤阳宗比比皆是，根本就算不上人才。”
说到这里，许凌顿了一下，接着说道：“据我表哥说，在宗门内灵气要比我们俗世家族中高上很多，而且还配给丹药，去年我表哥回来的时候，已经是炼气期第三层的修为了。”

The room suddenly became quiet, and Xu Li said softly: "Yes!"
"Really? Who are they? Tell me!" Xu Ziyan asked curiously.
"I now believe that you live in a remote mountain village, Ziyan. You don't even know about the famous people on the mainland! You can imagine how isolated the place where you live is." At this point, he glanced at Xu Ziyan with emotion and sighed softly: "If your uncle hadn't discovered you, a peerless talent would have been buried like this."
Xu Ziyan blushed in embarrassment after being praised, and whispered softly: "Xu Li, please stop laughing at me. I have little experience. Please tell me quickly."
Xu Li's face suddenly changed, and she said to Xu Ziyan extremely seriously: "Zi Yan, you will definitely not be a thing in the pool in the future. You will definitely soar into the sky. Don't forget us then."
"Yes! Ziyan, don't forget us." Several other people also looked at Xu Ziyan extremely seriously at this time and said, with expectations in their eyes.
Xu Ziyan was suddenly at a loss by everyone, but she quickly understood that this was because everyone had imagined their future, and hoped that after becoming a strong person, she could take care of them. Because to put it bluntly, the four people in front of me started practicing at the age of three, and they barely reached the fifth level of acquired cultivation until they were fifteen years old. There was indeed no major development. Even if Xu Ziyan keeps taking pills for them, it is impossible to become a peak existence. So it is normal for them to have this idea.
After thinking about all this, Xu Ziyan quickly adjusted her mentality. She knew that if she was still modest at this time, she might be misunderstood by everyone. So he smiled and said:
"If I really entrust your good words to soar into the sky in the future, Ziyan will definitely not forget everyone's affection today."
"Okay!" Everyone was overjoyed, clasping their hands and laughing.
After laughing, Xu Li organized her words slightly and said softly:
"This continent is very big. Our Xu family is located in the north of the continent. Due to our status, we don't know much. I only know that there are four major families in the north, namely the Han family in Juque City, the Zhou family in Canglang City, the Yang family in Nanlin City and our Xu family in Zhongdu City.
It is said that the Zhou family in Canglang City has a genius named Zhou Hao. He is the son of the current head of the Zhou family. At the age of three, he practiced cultivation, at the age of five, he broke through to the fifth level of acquired nature, and at the age of seven, he entered the innate level. Now eighteen years old, he is already at the fifth level of Qi refining stage.
The Yang family in Nanlin City also has a genius named Yang Linglong, the daughter of the current head of the Yang family. Her progress is almost the same as that of Zhou Hao. She is now eighteen years old and at the fifth level of Qi refining stage.
As for the Han family in Juque City, there are no talented people. It is said that the most outstanding young generation of the Han family is a young master named Han Cheng. He is seventeen years old today, but he only has the cultivation level of the second level of Qi refining stage. The most outstanding person in our Xu family is Uncle Ninth's son, named Xu Tianlang. It is said that he is about to break through to the third level of the Qi Refining Stage. "
"So the two most powerful people are Zhou Hao and Yang Linglong?"
Xu Ziyan asked softly. After listening to Xu Li's words, she couldn't help but feel a little disappointed. Now I am only fifteen years old, and I have only practiced for a few months, and I have reached the second level of Qi refining period.
She believed that with the help of her elixir, she could make a talisman array when her talisman-making skills reached the third level. At that time, I will make a spirit-gathering talisman array for myself. With the dual help of the elixir and the talisman array, my realm will be faster. Although I started late, I firmly believe that when I am eighteen years old, I will not be worse than Yang Linglong and Zhou Hao. And as time goes by, I will definitely surpass them and even keep them far away.Far behind.
"No!" Xu Li shook her head and said: "This is only in the north, I don't know about other places. And these are only masters in the secular world. As for the disciples in the sect, we are not able to know. But there is one What is certain is that the masters in the sect must be much higher than the people in the world. If Yang Linglong and Zhou Hao enter the sect, they don't need to enter any big sect, even those small sects may not even be considered medium. "
"Really? How do you know?"
"Xu Ling knows more about this, let Xu Ling speak." Xu Li looked at Xu Ling.
Xu Ling did not refuse, and continued Xu Li's words: "My distant cousin was chosen by a small sect called Chiyang Sect five years ago. When he entered Chiyang Sect, he was at the first level of the Qi Refining Stage. Last year he came back to visit his relatives because he said that the first level of Qi Refining Stage was the lowest level of cultivation in Chiyang Sect. People with the level of Yu Linglong and Zhou Qiang are everywhere in Chiyang Sect, and they are not considered talents at all."
At this point, Xu Ling paused and then said: "According to my cousin, the spiritual energy in the sect is much higher than that in our secular family, and pills are also provided. When my cousin came back last year, he was already at the third level of Qi refining period."
